world.title: Foldable iPhone launch expected by end-2026, bo...
world.description: Apple is expected to launch a foldable iPhone alongside a refreshed Pro model in September 2026, with other variants following in early 2027. This new product could impact Apple's fiscal 2026 results and is already highly anticipated, with an 81% market probability of release by year-end 2026. Analysts differ on the impact: Bank of America warns of margin pressure due to higher component costs, while Morgan Stanley highlights strong demand and potential for premium upgrades without hurting core sales. The stock trades near $305 with an $330 consensus target, and a successful foldable launch could drive a positive re-rating into fiscal 2027.
